terminals.name: dev
terminals.description: Next.js 16 dev server (Turbopack) on http://localhost:3000. Runs in demo mode when Supabase env vars are unset; set NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL and NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY (and optionally XAI_API_KEY) as secrets to enable auth, database, and AI features.
